title: Wedding
description: A couple's wedding, owned by exactly one tenant. The aggregate the planner and the couple collaborate on, and the seam where the planning engine (strategy genome / North Star) connects in a later phase. Always accessed through a tenant-scoped repository: the lookup key is (tenant_id, wedding_id), never wedding_id alone, so ids need not be globally unique. See product/README.md.

wedding_id.description: Identity within the owning tenant's partition, injected from the id generator. Not a global key — two tenants may hold the same wedding_id without collision because the lookup key is (tenant_id, wedding_id).

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. In the tenant-scoped repository this field is ONLY ever compared to the context's tenant_id (to veto a cross-tenant write); it is never used to select the partition (the context is). A payload tenant_id different from the context is rejected (PRODUCT.CROSS_TENANT_WRITE).

couple_display_name.description: The couple's display name, e.g. 'Alex & Sam'.

status.description: Planning lifecycle. planning = onboarding the couple; active = under active planning; completed = the wedding has happened; cancelled = called off.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time, from the injected clock (never ambient).
